scope: VCVio deprecation migration, stage S4 (plan doc/impl/vcvio-deprecation-migration-plan.md section 7: AdaptiveSeal*, CtxPrefix*, PqxdhFull*, PqxdhKem*, PqxdhLive*, PqxdhStateful*, CtxIndependent*, PqxdhOptional* and the merged cycle PqxdhJoint*/PqxdhDynamic*/PqxdhPhase1*): restatement of 78 theorems and the bodies of 5 probability definitions of 26 modules in VCVio's forward vocabulary (Pr{let x <- mx}[...] and EvalDistEq), with out-of-build certificates (82 inverse-map, 1 textual fallback); 16 transitional twins and their later-stage consumers; 16 scripted later-stage consumer sites; the hash-pinned PqxdhJointIdentity.lean edited under D5 with its getter-profile.py digest updated; phase B proof rewrites in the 28 stage modules; Lean-only validation.

commits.42320bc1b8e15a294bc677b3d5db3a0b9bcc02d5: Migrate VCVio stage S4 to the forward probability vocabulary
commits.docs: the commit that adds this receipt

owner_decisions.item 4 (decision 2026-10-19): D1-D5 and D8-D11 as recommended in plan section 11; D5: edit PqxdhJointIdentity.lean in S4 and update the getter-profile.py digest; D6 phase B included
owner_decisions.item 5 (decision 2026-10-19, revising D7: Lean-only validation per stage: make check-lean, make check-inventory, the step 7 scans and the certificates; no verify-in-shell, ProVerif, transcript fidelity, cargo, Go or Python checks (check-inventory itself runs getter-profile.py and its test)
owner_decisions.amendments: A1, A1.1 and A2 items 1-3 (/tmp/bc-arc-scratch/vcvio-migration/AMENDMENTS.md, recorded in the plan copy); A2 item 4 pending the owner

earlier_twin_removed: PqxdhProjectionCollisions.evalSPMF_split_uniformJointKdfStream_vcvioLegacy (stage S3; its only consumer, PqxdhFullSecretInputKdf.projectedOutput_uniform, now uses the restated theorem; its generated helper _simp_1_1 and its inventory pins are gone with it)

consumer_sites_patched.decision: restated wrappers get no transitional twin in S4 (a twin of PqxdhJointIdentity.advantage would add and later remove a declaration in the hash-pinned file); later-stage proofs that depend on a restated wrapper's old body (unfolding with simp only/rw, closing a goal stated over the old body definitionally, or applying a HonestKeyCompatibility hypothesis as the old equation), which the reference probe cannot see, are patched at their sites through the allowlisted bridge or with the forward lemma; the same replaces the twin of PqxdhStatefulPhase1Authentication.privateSourcePrefix_borrowed_complete, whose old statement's delaboration names the auxiliary matcher privateSourcePrefix.match_1 (auxLemma linter in every header variant of the CertTools-printed text; a twin copied verbatim from the base source text, which the S4 equivalence review found to state the base statement up to a structurally identical regenerated matcher, was not tried); ctxPrefixBadProbability needs neither a twin nor a patch (its only later proof user reaches it through equations with unchanged types); recorded after the S4 reviews as amendment A3 of the plan (/tmp/bc-arc-scratch/vcvio-migration/AMENDMENTS.md)

lean_changes.statements: probOutput -> Pr{let x <- mx}[x = a]; probEvent -> Pr{let x <- mx}[p x] (old lambda binder names kept; a bare predicate p becomes Pr{let result <- mx}[p result], which the certificate's inverse map rebuilds by eta reduction); 𝒮[A] = 𝒮[B] -> EvalDistEq A B (amendment A1, no =ᵈ), also in the hypotheses `compatible` of PqxdhOptionalKemSource.directTargetContinuation_eq_total and sourceContinuation_eq_actual and in the body of HonestKeyCompatibility
lean_changes.pinned_file: PqxdhJointIdentity.lean: the single body line of `advantage` (Pr[= true | game ...] -> Pr{let x <- game ...}[x = true]); getter-profile.py SOURCE_SHA256 49f2746c41bf71f3b0e9bb966f4fdfa795d70fca95e11442660717ea9a3e3a6c -> d9b9c25ac490e14743fe77ebfe6ae476d01fd22b8e5dba763f3e5faacf0c1a37 (D5); check-inventory runs test-getter-profile.py and getter-profile.py

PqxdhKemIndCca: VCVioForwardOracleComp (after its existing imports: placed before KeyEncapMech it reordered the downstream import closure, and PqxdhInitializerSecrecy.runtimeOfImpl_noFail_bool then synthesized IsProbabilityMeasure through the SPMF lift; the final order restores the base proof term)

lean_changes.editing: exact-replacement specifications per module (S4/edits/scripts/*.py, applied by rep.py to copies of the originals), groups built bottom-up with twin steps between them (A, B1, B2, C, D1, D2) because consumer modules of later stages sit between the stage's layers

findings.invisible_wrapper_dependencies: the reference probe records references in statements and proof terms; it cannot see a proof that depends on a restated wrapper's old body by definitional unfolding, by its equation lemma (folded away), or by applying a wrapper-typed hypothesis; the partial builds, three full builds and a window scan for facade lemmas near the wrappers and the definitions built on them found the 15 sites
findings.pr_expansion: simp only with bind_assoc, bind_pure_comp or pure_bind on a goal that contains Pr{...} rewrites the event expansion itself (𝒟[mx >>= fun x => pure (p x)] {True}); the proofs use explicit computation-shape equations, prEvent_eq_evalDist_decide with Bool.decide_eq_true, or the 𝒟[mx >>= f] {True} forms after deliberate flattening
findings.toolchain_deprecations: if_pos and if_neg are deprecated in this Lean core (2026-07-21); the new proofs use ite_eq_left and ite_eq_right
findings.layout: a continuation line inside Pr{...} left of the column of its let ends the doSeq; multi-line computations are parenthesized
findings.import_order: a new shim import placed before an existing VCVio import of a low module reordered the downstream import closure and changed which IsProbabilityMeasure instance a later proof (PqxdhInitializerSecrecy.runtimeOfImpl_noFail_bool) synthesized; gate G4 now requires that no theorem outside the edited set changes its proof term
findings.textual_fallback: PqxdhFullSecretInputKdf.projectedOutput_uniform has the S3 evalSPMF_first32 shape (two evalSPMF at definitionally equal element types)
findings.twintext_linter_panics: while CertTools elaborated candidate twin commands in memory (tryCommandText), outside the build, Lean's unused-variable linter panicked on some of them (PANIC at String.Slice.pos!, Init.Data.String.Basic:1661:4, offset not at a valid UTF-8 character boundary, inside Lean.Linter.UnusedVariables.unusedVariables): logs twintext-B1 48, twintext-D1 6, twintext-D2 6, none in twintext-A, -A2 and -C or in the S2 and S3 twin-text logs; the runs exit 0 except B1 (rc 1, the intended failure for privateSourcePrefix_borrowed_complete). No effect on the chosen headers, which depend only on the elaboration messages, or on the build (0 panics in check-lean-0, -4, -5, -6 and the validation run); recorded after the S4 hygiene review (H4)

build.command: make -C beaconcrypt-core check-lean SHELL=bash (proof shell, two-file flake copy of central's flake.nix/flake.lock)
build.partial_builds: lake builds of the stage groups (logs/lake-A, -B1..B1d, -B2, -C1, -C1b, -C2, -D1, -D1b, -D2a..D2d), each with no warning in a stage module
build.iterations: check-lean-1..3 each failed in exactly one later-stage module that depended on a restated wrapper's old body (PqxdhServerAuthAssumptions, PqxdhServerAuthIntermediate, PqxdhServerAuthCommonAuthentication), each fixed by a recorded consumer site; check-lean-4 rc 0; check-lean-5 after the import-order fix
